content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Ariyalur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ariyalur.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Ariyalur Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Assistant and Office Assistant posts is 06 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree to be eligible for both the Junior Assistant and Office Assistant positions. Specific details regarding the type of graduation may be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DCPU Ariyalur recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 42 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories, which would be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the DCPU Ariyalur vacancies?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the nature of the job and the contract period?
faq.answer: The posts are temporary and offered on a one-year contract basis. This means the employment is for a fixed duration of one year.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DCPU Ariyalur, which is https://ariyalur.nic.in. Links are also provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by DCPU Ariyalur. These are for the posts of Junior Assistant (1 post) and Office Assistant (1 post).

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary details for the Junior Assistant and Office Assistant posts have not been specified in the notification. However, it is mentioned that these are contract-based positions.

faq.question: Q10. What documents do I need to submit with my application?
faq.answer: You will need to attach self-attested copies of your required educational certificates, along with other necessary documents like ID proof and photographs, as specified in the official notification.
